meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话，自动回忆历史并沉淀洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发智能体，需要让它记住多轮对话的关键信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building AI agents that need to remember context across conversations.

howto.what: 在容器镜像里装上 mnemon 并注册 Claude Code 钩子:Claude 每次回答前会先调取相关历史记忆,每轮结束后把新的要点存下来;记忆写入挂载的 .claude/ 目录,容器重启后仍在。
howto.when: 当 agent group 用默认 Claude provider(container.json 里没有 provider 键,或为 claude)时生效;若该 group 设成 opencode 等其他 provider,钩子不会运行。装好后每次容器启动都会跑一次 setup。

say.text: 把这个技能应用到容器,给 agent 加上 mnemon 持久记忆。
say.note: 会安装 mnemon 并注册 Claude Code 钩子。

say.text: 重启服务后,确认 mnemon 钩子已经注册成功。
测试记忆:开一个新会话,提一下上一轮聊过的内容。
say.note: 正常情况下 mnemon 会自动带出相关上下文。

howto.what_en: Installs mnemon in the agent container image and registers Claude Code hooks: Claude recalls relevant past context before each reply and stores new insights after each turn. Memory lives in the mounted .claude/ dir and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Works on agent groups using the default Claude provider (no provider key, or provider: claude in container.json). If a group uses another provider such as opencode, the hooks never run.

say_en.text: Apply this skill to the container to give the agent mnemon memory.
say_en.note: Installs mnemon and registers Claude Code hooks.

say_en.text: After restarting, check whether the mnemon hooks are registered.
say_en.note: Checks docker logs and settings.json in the container.

say_en.text: Test recall: start a new session and mention something from earlier.
say_en.note: mnemon should surface the context without you restating it.
